subject: Geopolitics
title: Currency Wars and De-dollarization
description: Learn Currency Wars and De-dollarization in one minute.

hook.text: Saudi Arabia considered pricing oil in yuan instead of dollars. If it does, the global financial system shifts.

buildup.text: The petrodollar system since 1974 means oil trades in dollars, which supports US borrowing and global influence.

discovery.text: De-dollarization means reducing reliance on the US dollar. BRICS nations trade increasingly in local currencies.

twist.text: No currency is ready to replace the dollar. The yuan lacks convertibility. The euro lacks political unity.

climax.text: De-dollarization won't happen in a crash. It'll happen slowly — then suddenly, as trust erodes bit by bit.

punchline.text: The dollar's power lasts exactly as long as trust in it does.

quiz.question: What supports the US dollar's global dominance?
options: The US having the largest gold reserves
Oil being priced in dollars since the 1974 petrodollar system
